change: Add the nine missing deterministic English cache entries required by the static localized-route production build.
root_cause: New Dutch growth-loop copy was present in public pages without corresponding deterministic entries in the static English translation cache while production builds require cache completeness and disallow network translation.
prevention_rule: Every new public Dutch string that enters the static localized-route build must ship with its deterministic English cache entry in the same lineage before production promotion.
